newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Security Bank Q1 net 208.43 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Security Bank Q1 net 208.43 mln pesos.

text.p: Security Bank Corp told the Philippine Stock Exchange on Monday its net income in the first quarter of 1997 rose to 208.43 million pesos from 118.6 million in the year-ago period.
In a statement to the bourse, the bank said it posted an interest income of 1.13 billion pesos during the first quarter compared with 712 million pesos in the year-ago period.
After deducting interest expense, the bank made a net interest income of 519 million pesos in the first quarter.
Its other income for the period amounted to 217 million pesos. Other income included service charges, fees, commissions and foreign exchange profit.
